_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard: two Disk II drives and a hard disk controller. Slot ids are what project manifests record.

slots.title: Disk II drive 1
slots.help: Disk images for drive 1 (slot 6): DOS-order .dsk/.do, ProDOS-order .po, nibble .nib, .woz, or a 140K .2mg. The machine boots the first; the order here is the swap order used by the Next Disk 1 input.

slots.title: Disk II drive 2
slots.help: Disk images for drive 2. The first is in the drive at boot; Next Disk 2 cycles through the rest.

slots.title: Hard disk
slots.help: Up to two ProDOS hard disk images on a controller in slot 7. Writes go to the machine's overlay, which savestates carry; the file itself is never changed.
